# BranDigiOps

> BranDigiOps is an AI-powered growth intelligence platform based in
> Bengaluru, India, serving Indian SMBs. It combines marketing strategy,
> AI content production, campaign execution, performance analytics and
> pre-tender lead intelligence (GrowthRadar) into one platform.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://brandigiops.com/): Growth Intelligence Suite overview
- [GrowthRadar](https://brandigiops.com/growth-radar): Pre-tender and signal-stage lead intelligence for PEB construction, government IT tenders and insurance
- [Who We Are](https://brandigiops.com/about): Team and founder
- [Blogs](https://brandigiops.com/blogs): Guides and analysis
- [Free AEO Audit](https://brandigiops.com/free-aeo-audit): Request a free AI-visibility snapshot

## Key facts

- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Serves: Indian SMBs and mid-market businesses
- Contact: tech@brandigiops.com | +91 7993191616
